control.name: CONTROL: known live visibility is marked unobserved

mutations.name: discard the live snapshot scalar and re-read metadata
accept unavailable snapshot values instead of probing the forge
collapse changing live visibility to private
guess private when the live fallback read fails
mutations.old:
// could-not-read (incl. empty/absent visibility) is unobserved, not a guessed pass
			return visibilityObservation{repo: repo}, nil
mutations.new:
// could-not-read (incl. empty/absent visibility) is unobserved, not a guessed pass
			return visibilityObservation{repo: repo, vis: "private", observed: true}, nil
